query.sql:
SELECT
  scope.registryEntries AS assets,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE decision.disposition = 'quarantine') AS quarantined,
  list_count(blockerCounts) AS blockerTypes,
  checks.actualAssetsAllQuarantined AS denyByDefault
FROM read_json_auto('output/audits/ielts-reading-rights-set1-2026-08-09/validation.json') AS report,
UNNEST(report.decisions) AS rows(decision)
GROUP BY ALL;

blocks.body: # IELTS Academic Reading — set-1 rights gate

## The control passes; the three passages do not

F0.2a now identifies and fingerprints all three Reading sections in `set-1`, but every actual record remains `unknown-quarantined`. The result is a working denial gate, not copyright clearance, IELTS approval or a content-quality verdict.

## Advancement needs five independent facts

An asset can only become eligible for later editorial review when its module is declared, authorship is identified, a basis-specific rights record is verified, factual review is complete and an independent human reviewer approves. Missing records and changed hashes fail closed.

## The match is a warning signal, not permission

A publisher catalog and two directed external pages support a high-confidence identification with Cambridge IELTS 5 Academic Reading Test 2. No authorization evidence was located in the sources reviewed. The search was directed and non-exhaustive; it neither proves universal absence nor reaches a legal conclusion.

## The registry is safe to audit

The durable registry and blind packet contain IDs, hashes, statuses and evidence references only. Recursive guards reject passage, question, option, answer-key and common PII fields. Automated triage is explicitly marked as incapable of human approval.

## Panel scope

A PASS means the F0.2a control is reproducible and conservatively scoped. It does not validate the learner-facing mock, its answers, its pedagogy, its accessibility or its legal publishability.

## Open work

The parent F0.2 remains open. This slice does not enforce quarantine in the public mock runner, resolve ownership, collect licenses, verify factual claims, declare module at asset level, adjudicate keys or audit the UI. Those remain separate, named subunits.

evidence.label: IELTS mock set-1 source record
evidence.note: El archivo padre se rotula IELTS Academic; esa etiqueta permite inferir el módulo, pero no sustituye una declaración editorial por activo.

evidence.label: IELTS copyright and trade mark statement
evidence.note: Política oficial revisada para delimitar reutilización y necesidad de autorización. No concede licencia a este repositorio.

evidence.label: Cambridge ELT catalogue — Cambridge IELTS 5
evidence.note: Catálogo oficial que identifica Cambridge IELTS 5 Student’s Book with answers, ISBN 978-0-521-67701-1. No acredita que WeLearn tenga licencia.

evidence.label: External identification of Cambridge 5 Test 2 passage sequence
evidence.note: Página externa usada solo para cotejo dirigido de la secuencia Bakelite / What’s so funny? / The Birth of Scientific English.

evidence.label: External identification of The Birth of Scientific English
evidence.note: Página externa usada solo para reforzar la identificación del tercer pasaje; no es evidencia de autorización.

audit.findings: 3/3 activos conservan rightsBasis unknown-quarantined; la identificación editorial probable no se trata como licencia y la búsqueda externa se declara dirigida/no exhaustiva.
Cobertura exacta 3/3, hashes alineados, fail-closed ante registro ausente, drift, schema/módulo/basis inválidos, evidencia incompleta, fechas imposibles y duplicados.

audit.scope: Identidad y límite del packet; no calidad de preguntas
audit.findings: Academic continúa inferido, no declarado; el packet no contiene pasajes, preguntas, opciones ni claves y no permite fingir aprobación IELTS o pedagógica.

audit.scope: Separación entre automatización y decisión humana
audit.findings: La auto-revisión normalizada, la aprobación automática, estados desconocidos, campos vacíos, keys variantes y PII de estudiante/contacto quedan bloqueados.
No cambió ninguna tarea, instrucción, decisión o feedback del estudiante; corresponde ➖, no una aprobación.

audit.scope: Sin ruta, componente ni DOM nuevos
audit.findings: No existe superficie visual atribuible a F0.2a; corresponde ➖, no una aprobación.
El gate es estático y ejecutable en Node; runtime enforcement y navegador permanecen en unidades posteriores.
